variable-length-reach: Use when the question asks which concepts reach, or are connected to, an anchor concept through RELATED_TO relations within one to three hops (related topics around a concept).
shortest-path: Use when the question asks for the shortest path, shortest chain, or minimum number of RELATED_TO steps between two named concepts.
citation-reach: Use when the question asks which documents are cited by, or reachable through CITES citations from, a document, up to a depth.
team-readable-documents: Use when the question asks which documents about a topic a team (Platform) can read, using semantic / vector similarity under access control.
